title: graph layer: load issue set once per invocation
description:
Ensure the CLI reads the issue set exactly once per invocation: a command loads the index and issues once, then serves every query (id resolution, related/incoming relationship titles, epic counts, dependency blocking) from that in-memory data.

This is NOT the case today: Operations::get_related_titles loads each related issue individually (N+1 file reads inside show/epic display), convert reads the target issue plus the full issue set plus the index, and add_relationship/remove_relationship interleave several storage loads in one invocation. The TUI already loads each project once per refresh (load_project_data in tui.rs); the CLI has no equivalent.

Implement an operations/graph layer that reads all files once per invocation and routes every command through it (counts, incoming relationships, id resolution, dependency checks).
